boards.title: Your First Weekend at Texas Christian University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A relaxed, under-21-safe sequence for learning the central campus, finding student resources and trying a documented Horned Frog tradition.

cards.title: Start at Frog Fountain
cards.subtitle: Campus Commons · Friday arrival
cards.notes: Use the fountain as a simple first landmark, then orient yourself to the Commons and nearby BLUU before heading indoors.
cards.short_summary: A named Campus Commons landmark and a clear first meeting point.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU identifies Frog Fountain as a Campus Commons landmark at 2855 Main Drive and describes it as a focal point of campus life.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus landmark; follow posted campus access guidance.

cards.title: Take a Commons lap
cards.subtitle: Campus Commons · Friday afternoon
cards.notes: Walk the greenspace and notice the buildings around it; it is an easy way to connect the fountain, union and residence-hall area.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor space framed by major campus buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU describes Campus Commons as an open greenspace with seating, fountains and surrounding residence halls, Scharbauer Hall and the Brown-Lupton University Union.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; use it in accordance with posted campus rules.

cards.title: Have a first campus meal
cards.subtitle: Market Square, BLUU · Friday evening
cards.notes: Find Market Square on the BLUU’s second-floor north wing and check the current dining page or posted hours before relying on it.
cards.short_summary: TCU’s all-you-care-to-eat dining facility in the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU identifies Market Square as its all-you-care-to-eat facility in the north wing of the second floor of the Brown-Lupton University Union.
cards.access_notes: Dining access and hours can vary; confirm current service and meal-plan or payment eligibility.

cards.title: Learn the BLUU layout
cards.subtitle: 2901 Stadium Drive · Friday evening
cards.notes: Make a short pass through the three floors to locate seating, dining and student-service offices for future errands and meetups.
cards.short_summary: The campus union links dining, seating and student services.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU says the Brown-Lupton University Union is the gateway to Campus Commons and houses primary residential dining, retail options and student services offices.
cards.access_notes: Located at 2901 Stadium Drive; individual offices and services may have separate access hours.

cards.title: Set up a study base
cards.subtitle: Mary Couts Burnett Library · Saturday morning
cards.notes: Choose a quiet zone or locate a group study room now, so you know where to return when coursework starts moving quickly.
cards.short_summary: A library with mapped quiet zones, study rooms and service desks.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s official locations guide lists quiet study zones, group study rooms, service desks and floor maps for Mary Couts Burnett Library.
cards.source_title: Building maps, locations and directions — TCU Library
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current building-access and room-reservation guidance before visiting.

cards.title: Locate the Rec Center
cards.subtitle: 3005 Stadium Drive · Saturday midday
cards.notes: Walk over to see the recreation facility, then review its current access policies and activity schedules before planning a workout.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation facility available to registered TCU students.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU states that registered students are members with access to the University Recreation Center and lists the facility at 3005 Stadium Drive.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation & Wellness Promotion — TCU Dean of Students
cards.access_notes: Registered TCU students have access; review current facility policies and hours before arrival.

cards.title: Find the TCU Sundial
cards.subtitle: Near Walsh Performing Arts Center · Saturday afternoon
cards.notes: Pause at the functional sundial and look for the horned-frog detail in its compass rose; it is a durable west-campus navigation point.
cards.short_summary: A 2015 functional artwork calibrated for TCU’s location.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU describes the TCU Sundial near the Walsh Performing Arts Center as a functional precision instrument installed and dedicated in 2015.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor artwork on campus; observe without climbing or interfering with the installation.

cards.title: Meet the Lucky Frog
cards.subtitle: Between Sadler and Reed halls · Saturday afternoon
cards.notes: Find the pointy horned-frog statue between Sadler and Reed halls and take in the documented luck tradition without blocking the walkway.
cards.short_summary: A named statue tied to a documented TCU good-luck custom.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU documents a tradition of rubbing the nose of the pointy horned frog statue between Sadler and Reed halls for luck.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor statue; be considerate of nearby classes, residents and pedestrian traffic.

cards.title: Recognize the stadium route
cards.subtitle: Stadium Drive · Saturday evening
cards.notes: Walk the public perimeter along Stadium Drive and identify the stadium in relation to the BLUU and Recreation Center for future event-day wayfinding.
cards.short_summary: A major map-listed campus landmark beside the union district.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU’s official campus map lists Amon G. Carter Stadium and places it near the Brown-Lupton University Union and Stadium Drive.
cards.access_notes: Use public routes only; stadium entry and event access depend on current policies and tickets.

cards.title: Learn the Riff Ram cheer
cards.subtitle: A TCU tradition · Sunday wrap-up
cards.notes: Read the university’s tradition guide, then practice the school-specific cheer respectfully before a future campus gathering or game.
cards.short_summary: A documented Horned Frog cheer to carry into campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: TCU’s official traditions page identifies “Riff, Ram, Bah, Zoo!” among its Horned Frog traditions.
cards.access_notes: Participate where appropriate and follow event staff instructions and venue policies.
